snapshot.shared_with_visuals: Same FROZEN_VALIDATION.npz and FROZEN_RECORD.json as build_gait_visuals.py / REPLAY.html.

definitions.geometry: Original forward_kinematics on saved motion/rest, CPU only. Shared fixed-window anchored scene coordinates, metres, Y up; physical root is motion[:3]*2+rest[0]. No GT alignment, floor snap, temporal shift or smoothing applied to outputs.
definitions.feet: Native 22-joint skeleton indices 10/11 (left/right foot), not mesh sole vertices.
definitions.local_motion: Each motion uses its own root inverse rotation and root-centred foot positions. Local z is body forward/back. This deliberately removes heading/root drift from articulation diagnostics; heading/root errors are reported separately.
definitions.low_speed_stance_proxy: GT 3D foot finite-difference speed <0.2m/s at 30Hz, exactly the existing raw_metrics criterion. It is a kinematic slow-foot mask, not ground-contact truth or verified physical support. Published foot speed includes vertical motion; horizontal speed is separate.
definitions.phase_proxy: Compare continuous L_z-R_z waveforms at identical time; correlation measures coarse relative motion, not precise physical contact. Optional best lag within +/-0.5s is diagnostic only; reported outputs remain unshifted.
definitions.single_foot_intervals: Exactly one foot satisfies low-speed proxy; left=1/right=2. Intervals must last >=3 velocity samples (0.1s), no smoothing. Exchanges count changes between retained exclusive intervals; not literal stride count.
definitions.root_drift: Terminal horizontal (pred_root-GT_root) error minus its first-frame value, norm in XZ. Only the diagnostic subtracts initial error; displayed/primary predictions are unchanged.
definitions.contact_head: Not stored in validation NPZ; cannot score learned contact-head labels here. Low-speed proxy agreement must not be presented as contact-head accuracy.
definitions.penetration: No signed sole-to-verified-support distance computed here. Sliding/root drift are distinct from penetration.
definitions.historical_comparison: 8k/9k/10k comparisons use existing fixed-window logs; old per-frame predictions were not retained, so new phase/drift metrics are computed only for this frozen latest snapshot.
